sectorImpacts.reason: Higher US rates can lead to slower economic growth, potentially reducing demand for IT services from US clients.
Rising interest rates generally improve net interest margins for banks, though global rate hikes can also increase funding costs.
Higher borrowing costs due to rising rates can compress margins for NBFCs, which rely on market funding.
Increased interest rates can dampen housing demand by making mortgages more expensive for consumers.
A stronger dollar and fears of global economic slowdown due to rate hikes can negatively impact commodity prices, including metals.
